newsitem.title: USA: Emmis says buys St. Louis radio stations.
newsitem.headline: Emmis says buys St. Louis radio stations.

text.p: Emmis Broadcasting Corp said it bought radio stations WKBQ-FM, WKBQ-AM and WKKX-FM, all in St. Louis, from Zimco Inc, a division of Zimmer Radio Group, for $42.5 million.
Emmis said it also owns and operates KSHE-FM in St. Louis.
The acquired stations will be subject to a time brokerage agreement to take effect on or about December 1.
WKBQ-FM and AM operate at 104.1 MHZ and 1380 kHz, respectively, with a Top 40 format. WKKX-FM operates at 106.5 MHZ with a country format, Emmis said.
